Container.Name: cadcraft-web
Container.Overview: CADCraft Web is a community-maintained Docker image that serves CADCraft, a modern 2D and 3D computer-aided design and drafting application, through a browser-based WebAssembly interface. The upstream project includes CAD workflows such as drawing, layers, dimensions, hatches, blocks, object snaps, and DXF support. The container only serves the static web application; drawing and graphics operations run in the browser.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: CADCraft CAD Craft 2D CAD 3D CAD Drafting DXF Drawing Engineering Design Browser WebAssembly WASM
Container.Requires: No special privileges, database, or persistent data volumes are required for the standard deployment. The web interface is served over HTTP on container port 8080. Browser graphics support and device performance affect the experience. WebGPU requires a secure context; use HTTPS through a reverse proxy for remote access. WebGL2 fallback availability depends on the browser and device.

Config.Name: HTTP Port
Config.Description: Host port used to access the CADCraft Web interface. The container listens on port 8080.
